        [0.099655, 0.099655],[0.298965, 0.099655],[0.500000, 0.099655],[0.701035, 0.099655],[0.900345, 0.099655],

    for step in (0.01, 0.005, 0.002):

            for i in range(n):

                    trial[i, 0] = np.clip(trial[i, 0] + dx, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
                    trial[i, 1] = np.clip(trial[i, 1] + dy, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
                    tr = lp_radii(trial)

def lp_radii(centers):
    """LP-optimal radii for fixed centers: maximize sum r_i s.t. r_i+r_j<=d_ij and r_i<=wall_i."""
    n = centers.shape[0]
    c = -np.ones(n)

    # Pairwise constraints
    A = []
    b = []
    for i in range(n):
        xi, yi = centers[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            d = float(np.hypot(xi - centers[j, 0], yi - centers[j, 1]))
            row = np.zeros(n)
            row[i] = 1.0
            row[j] = 1.0
            A.append(row)
            b.append(d)

    # Wall constraints
    wall = np.minimum.reduce([centers[:, 0], centers[:, 1], 1.0 - centers[:, 0], 1.0 - centers[:, 1]])
    for i in range(n):
        row = np.zeros(n)
        row[i] = 1.0
        A.append(row)
        b.append(float(wall[i]))

    res = linprog(c, A_ub=np.asarray(A), b_ub=np.asarray(b), bounds=[(0, None)] * n, method="highs")
    return res.x if res.success else None

    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.patches import Circle

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))

    # Draw unit square
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Draw circles

        ax.text(center[0], center[1], str(i), ha="center", va="center")
